exploring.label: Exploring
exploring.description: Thesis work. We are reading the market, meeting operators and testing whether the opportunity is real.

development.label: In development
development.description: Concept, brand and operating model are being built. Not yet trading.

coming-soon.label: Coming soon
coming-soon.description: Scoped and scheduled. Work begins once the ventures ahead of it are standing on their own.

ventures.name: Meridian Trade
ventures.oneLiner: An export house for Sri Lankan categories that deserve to be sold under their own name.
ventures.description: A study into owning the brand layer above commodity export — starting with a single category, a single corridor, and a small number of buyers who care about provenance.

ventures.name: Ratna Atelier
ventures.oneLiner: Ceylon stones, traceable from the pit to the setting, designed for people who ask where things come from.
ventures.description: An exploration of verified provenance as a product feature: certification, cutting and design held under one roof, sold directly to collectors and independent jewellers.

ventures.name: Serendib House
ventures.oneLiner: A small hospitality format built around one place, done properly, and repeatable.
ventures.description: Concept work on a compact residence format — few keys, high craft, strong operating standards — designed so that the second property is as good as the first.

ventures.name: Longitude Studio
ventures.oneLiner: The narrative arm of the platform — film, editorial and photography for everything we build.
ventures.description: An in-house studio treated as infrastructure rather than agency spend: it gives every Gelian venture a credible voice from its first day, and it can eventually take outside work.

ventures.name: Portside Digital
ventures.oneLiner: Specialist technical teams sold on outcomes, not on hours or headcount.
ventures.description: An early look at narrow, senior service businesses built on Sri Lankan engineering and design talent, priced and positioned for buyers in mature markets.

ventures.name: Landfall
ventures.oneLiner: Market entry in both directions, with people who are actually accountable for the outcome.
ventures.description: A structure for helping credible foreign operators land in Sri Lanka — and Sri Lankan operators land abroad — through joint ventures, distribution and licensing rather than advice alone.
